Name: Halloween Puzzle Dreams
Author: bblueberry
Description:
[center]Every few nights in Fall and Winter, a nightly event will start in your room...
Escape from the [i]Stardew Valley Discord puzzle tasks[/i], or face your doom.

(Your doom comes another day. You're really in no danger.)
(But if you wake the dreams will stay. Better face your fears, stranger.)

[color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]Dreams[/b][/size][/color]

Find your way to the totem at the end of each dream maze.
Completing a world will bring you another dream in a few days, and with a wicked new world to escape.
You can wake up at any time by clicking the mouse. If you do, you'll have another chance in a week.

Earn rewards for each maze solved.
Complete all 4 for a unique statue and bragging rights in the #gathering-of-spirits.

[color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b][url=https://emojipedia.org/skull]💀[/url]  Nightmares[/b]  [url=https://emojipedia.org/skull]💀[/url][/size][/color]

Toggle  [b][color=#8e7cc3]Nightmare Mode[/color] [/b] from the config to hide the guide, lower the lights, and give yourself a frightful night.
Good luck. No extra rewards are given for beating Nightmare puzzles.
